Anyone sold their structured settlement? Was it worth it?

Thinking of selling part of my structured settlement. Got a quote but no idea if it is fair. What did it cost you?

I sold 5 years of payments in 2024. The company quoted a discount rate of 16%, which felt high, so I got two more quotes and ended at 12%. Comparing quotes saved me about $4,000.

Honestly it depends on your situation. Just be careful and read everything.
